Game Overview

Dungeon Master - Cult & Craft is a casual game built around step into the shadows as the mastermind of a dark dungeon, transforming stickmen into loyal followers. Extract resources, expand your domain, and nurture your cult within an immersive 3D world. Balance management and strategy to craft an empire in the depths.
